records.jp: あのー……<CR>だから私、料理班じゃないんですけど
records.en_original: Erm... Like I said before, I'm not part of the cooking team.
records.en_auxiliary: Erm... Like I said before, I'm not part of the cooking team.
records.en: Um...<CR>Like I said, I'm not on the cooking team.

records.jp: 今、食後のデザートについて話し合ってたんですけど<CR>意見が割れてしまって
records.en_original: We were talking about tonight's dessert, but we can't seem to agree on anything.
records.en_auxiliary: We were talking about tonight's dessert, but we can't seem to agree on anything.
records.en: We were discussing dessert after dinner, but<CR>our opinions split.

records.jp: 第三者の方に決めてもらおうと思って
records.en_original: So we thought we'd get a third party to settle it for us.
records.en_auxiliary: So we thought we'd get a third party to settle it for us.
records.en: So we thought we would have a third party decide.

records.jp: そういうお手伝いなら大歓迎！<CR>どんな意見が出てるの？
records.en_original: I'd be happy to help with that! What's up?
records.en_auxiliary: I'd be happy to help with that! What's up?
records.en: I'd be happy to help with that!<CR>What options are there?

records.jp: わたしからはミルフィーユを提案させてもらいました
records.en_original: I thought that we should have mille-feuille.
records.en_auxiliary: I thought that we should have mille-feuille.
records.en: I proposed mille-feuille.

records.jp: ただのミルフィーユじゃないわ。<CR>詩帆ったらパイ生地から作るって言うのよ
records.en_original: But not just regular mille-feuille, Shiho wants to make it with pie dough.
records.en_auxiliary: But not just regular mille-feuille, Shiho wants to make it with pie dough.
records.en: Not just any mille-feuille.<CR>Shiho says she wants to make the pastry from scratch.

records.jp: そんなに大変なの？
records.en_original: Is that really hard or something?
records.en_auxiliary: Is that really hard or something?
records.en: Is it really that hard?

records.jp: 必要な準備や工程が多いの。<CR>ご飯の片手間じゃ作れないわ
records.en_original: There's a lot of preparation and steps involved. We don't have time with the other cooking we have to do.
records.en_auxiliary: There's a lot of preparation and steps involved. We don't have time with the other cooking we have to do.
records.en: It requires a lot of preparation and many steps.<CR>You can't make it on the side while preparing dinner.

records.jp: その分早めに作業室に入ればいいんです
records.en_original: We just need to start earlier!
records.en_auxiliary: We just need to start earlier!
records.en: Then we simply need to enter the workroom earlier.

records.jp: 長時間労働……
records.en_original: She's ruthless...
records.en_auxiliary: She's ruthless...
records.en: Long working hours...

records.jp: 私はドーナツがいいと思うわ。<CR>生地を丸めて揚げるだけだし
records.en_original: I suggested we make donuts. All it takes is rolling out dough and frying it.
records.en_auxiliary: I suggested we make donuts. All it takes is rolling out dough and frying it.
records.en: I think donuts would be good.<CR>All you have to do is shape the dough and fry it.

records.jp: その、おやつにはいいと思うんですけど、<CR>食後にはちょっと重たいかなって
records.en_original: Donuts make a good snack, but I think they're a little heavy after a meal.
records.en_auxiliary: Donuts make a good snack, but I think they're a little heavy after a meal.
records.en: I think they would make a good snack,<CR>but they might be a little heavy after dinner.

records.jp: 一口サイズにすれば大丈夫よ
records.en_original: Not if we make them bite-sized.
records.en_auxiliary: Not if we make them bite-sized.
records.en: They will be fine if we make them bite-sized.

records.jp: 油跳ね……揚げ物の悪夢再び……
records.en_original: But the oil... It flies everywhere...
records.en_auxiliary: But the oil... It flies everywhere...
records.en: Oil splatters... The nightmare of frying returns...

records.jp: きららは？
records.en_original: What do you want to make, Kirara?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you want to make, Kirara?
records.en: What about Kirara?

records.jp: きららは正直、余計に働かなきゃいけないなら<CR>デザートなしでも……
records.en_original: To be honest, I'd be just as happy without dessert if it meant less work for us...
records.en_auxiliary: To be honest, I'd be just as happy without dessert if it meant less work for us...
records.en: To be honest, if Kirara has to work more,<CR>Kirara would be fine with no dessert...

records.jp: 強いて言うなら、わらび餅。<CR>あのぷるぷるをこの手で錬成してみたい
records.en_original: If I must, then warabimochi. I've always wanted to try making some.
records.en_auxiliary: If I must, then warabimochi. I've always wanted to try making some.
records.en: If forced to choose, warabimochi.<CR>Kirara wants to try creating that jiggle with her own hands.

records.jp: 星崎さんはどれがいいと思います？
records.en_original: What do you think, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you think, Ao?
records.en: Which do you think would be best, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: ミルフィーユかな
records.en_original: mille-feuille.
records.en_auxiliary: mille-feuille.
records.en: Mille-feuille, maybe.

records.jp: 本当ですか？
records.en_original: Really?
records.en_auxiliary: Really?
records.en: Really?

records.jp: こだわりたいって衝動は抑えない方がいいよ
records.en_original: Sometimes you gotta just go all out.
records.en_auxiliary: Sometimes you gotta just go all out.
records.en: You shouldn't suppress the urge to be particular about it.

records.jp: 星崎さん、わかってますね……
records.en_original: I'm so glad you understand...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm so glad you understand...
records.en: Hoshizaki-san, you understand...

records.jp: ケーキ屋さんにも負けないミルフィーユ、<CR>作ってみせます！
records.en_original: I'll show you a vanilla slice that will put even a patissier to shame!
records.en_auxiliary: I'll show you a vanilla slice that will put even a patissier to shame!
records.en: I'll make a mille-feuille<CR>that even a pastry shop couldn't beat!

records.jp: （きららたちには申し訳ないけど、<CR>めっちゃ楽しみだなぁ）
records.en_original: (I feel bad for Kirara and Mio, but I can't wait to try it!)
records.en_auxiliary: (I feel bad for Kirara and Mio, but I can't wait to try it!)
records.en: (I feel bad for Kirara and the others,<CR>but I'm really looking forward to it.)

records.jp: ドーナツかな。<CR>美弦さんらしいし
records.en_original: Donuts! They kinda remind me of Mio in a way.
records.en_auxiliary: Donuts! They kinda remind me of Mio in a way.
records.en: Donuts, maybe.<CR>They feel like Mio-san.

records.jp: どういうこと？
records.en_original: What's that supposed to mean?
records.en_auxiliary: What's that supposed to mean?
records.en: What do you mean?

records.jp: 素朴で家庭的？　みたいな？
records.en_original: It's simple and...homey, I guess?
records.en_auxiliary: It's simple and...homey, I guess?
records.en: Simple and homey? Something like that?

records.jp: なんだかそう言われると……恥ずかしいわね
records.en_original: That's...a little embarrassing.
records.en_auxiliary: That's...a little embarrassing.
records.en: Somehow, hearing you put it that way... is embarrassing.

records.jp: そこが美弦さんのいいとこなんだって
records.en_original: Those are the things that make you great, Mio!
records.en_auxiliary: Those are the things that make you great, Mio!
records.en: That's what is so great about you, Mio-san.

records.jp: わらび餅いいじゃん。夏っぽくて
records.en_original: Let's make warabimochi! It's so good in the summer!
records.en_auxiliary: Let's make warabimochi! It's so good in the summer!
records.en: Warabimochi sounds good. It feels summery.

records.jp: うむ。食欲なくても飲むように食べられる。<CR>それがわらび餅
records.en_original: Yes, it's perfect for snacking even when you're not particularly hungry.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, it's perfect for snacking even when you're not particularly hungry.
records.en: Indeed. Even without an appetite, it goes down almost like a drink.<CR>That's warabimochi.

records.jp: それに、一度でいいから手で触ってみたかったのだ。<CR>ぷるぷるを心ゆくまで堪能したい
records.en_original: Besides, I've always wanted to play with it at least once. I bet it's wonderfully jiggly.
records.en_auxiliary: Besides, I've always wanted to play with it at least once. I bet it's wonderfully jiggly.
records.en: Besides, Kirara has wanted to touch it with her hands at least once.<CR>Kirara wishes to enjoy the jiggle to her heart's content.

records.jp: たしかにそれって料理班の特権かも
records.en_original: I guess getting to play with the food is one of the upsides of being on the cooking team.
records.en_auxiliary: I guess getting to play with the food is one of the upsides of being on the cooking team.
records.en: That might be one of the perks of being on the cooking team.

records.jp: で、どうすんの？<CR>今から作るの？
records.en_original: So? Should we get started?
records.en_auxiliary: So? Should we get started?
records.en: So, what are you going to do?<CR>Are you making it now?

records.jp: そうですね。まだ時間ありますし、<CR>とりあえず試作してみましょうか
records.en_original: We've got time, let's do a test-run first.
records.en_auxiliary: We've got time, let's do a test-run first.
records.en: Yes. We've still got time,<CR>so why don't we make a test batch first?

records.jp: ありがとう愛央、帰っていいわよ
records.en_original: Thank you, Ao. You can go back now.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you, Ao. You can go back now.
records.en: Thank you, Ao. You may leave now.

records.jp: えっ？　試食タイムは？
records.en_original: Huh? What about the tasting?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? What about the tasting?
records.en: Huh? What about tasting it?

records.jp: 本来、デザート会議は極秘。<CR>完成版の披露を待つのだ
records.en_original: The dessert meeting is usually supposed to be top secret. You'll have to wait for the grand unveiling.
records.en_auxiliary: The dessert meeting is usually supposed to be top secret. You'll have to wait for the grand unveiling.
records.en: Dessert meetings are normally top secret.<CR>Wait until the finished version is unveiled.

records.jp: そんなぁ～<CR>こっからが楽しいのに……
records.en_original: No fair! I was so excited...
records.en_auxiliary: No fair! I was so excited...
records.en: Nooo~<CR>The fun was just about to start...
